title: Humans can't read URLs. How can we fix it? - HTTP 203
summary: Jake Archibald argues that URLs are nearly impossible for humans to interpret, especially for security. He walks through what browsers do about it, including highlighting the registrable domain, and floats a possible better design.
why: Referenced in debates over Chrome hiding URLs as a compelling case for why full URLs are hard even for experts.

quote.text: I think they make a compelling argument for hiding most of the url in part to prevent phishing
